title: Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass: Choosing a Network Access Control Platform
excerpt: Two leading NAC platforms for 802.1X, guest access and device profiling. Cisco ISE shines in Cisco networks; Aruba ClearPass, from HPE Aruba Networking, is known for multi-vendor flexibility.
verdict: Cisco ISE makes the most sense when your switches and wireless are already Cisco. ClearPass is the better fit for mixed-vendor networks that need flexible NAC policy, and many teams find it easier to get started with.
